title: Argentinian Bean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Argentina, featuring warm spices and wilted greens.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper, and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cannellini beans, diced tomatoes, and wilted spinach.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until the flavors have melded together, about 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
